source.scope: Residential photovoltaic applications with an approval (permission to operate) date; PG&E, SCE and SDG&E territories only (municipal utilities such as LADWP and SMUD are not in this dataset).
source.citation: California Distributed Generation Statistics (CPUC), Interconnected Project Sites data set, data through May 31, 2026 (downloaded Sept. 24, 2026)
source.costBasis: host-owned, PV-only (no storage), 1-25 kW DC, reported Total System Cost / System Size DC
source.installerNote: Installer names and CSLB license numbers as reported on utility interconnection applications (validated by the utility); counts are residential solar systems granted permission to operate. Not a ranking or endorsement.
source.note: Installer rows: top installers by residential systems granted permission to operate in 2025, each with its count for Jan 2024 - May 2026. Built by aggregate_companies.py with the filters of aggregate_dgstats.py.
